title: No shortcut to publication authority
summary: Every effectful response requires a fresh host-side decision bound to exact tenant, intention and narrative revisions, approved claims and current policy.
invariants: Brand Narrative Directive dev4 remains NO_DISPATCH and publicationAuthority=NONE, even READY_FOR_EXTERNAL_AUTHORITY_REVIEW.
Communications Discovery dev14 is evidence-only and HOLD must block release.
Intention Service dev11 READY does not itself approve narrative facts or audience permission.
Institutional Policy v0.8 selects fixed reviewed operative artefacts; LLM outputs never become policy.
